validation_selection.selection: Highest official validation MRR; no test results observed

protocols.nodes: Official Geom-GCN split 0; original Chameleon/Squirrel graphs. Coauthor-CS uses GraphAny's seed-42 stratified 300-total-label split.
protocols.joint: At most 5 training nodes per class and 20% of edges, same seed-42 subsets for both readouts; official validation labels additionally select the readout.
protocols.graphs: Nested stratified outer 10-fold / inner 5-fold SVM, seed 42; scaling learned within training folds. ± is outer-fold std. Label features for TU biochemical graphs; capped degree indicators for attribute-free IMDB-BINARY.
protocols.graph_fewshot: 5 or 20 total training graphs per class sampled inside each outer training fold. Inner selection uses only those support graphs; all other outer training labels are discarded. Paired supports for both readouts; all 10 outer test folds evaluated.
protocols.continual: Cora -> Citeseer -> Wisconsin -> Cornell -> Actor -> Amazon-ratings; future Minesweeper/Tolokers. Validation scores, original fixed NC readout and native LP AUC, separate from public readout comparisons.

computation: Same source checkpoint and V6 readout family. Ridge predicts in 1024-row float64 blocks using the same centered least-squares system. Symmetric eigenproblems retry in float64 after float32 convergence failure or nonfinite output.
